definitions.gloss: to trust; to rely on; to have confidence in
definitions.explanation: To place trust or confidence in a person, organization, or thing, believing they are reliable and dependable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{信頼|しんらい}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{信頼|しんらい}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This company is trusted by its customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{信頼|しんらい}することにした。
examples.english: Based on years of experience, I decided to trust her judgment.

notes:
Expresses deep, established trust in someone or something. Stronger and more formal than ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧, which can mean simply 'to believe.' ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧ implies reliability built over time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain trust
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧: to betray trust
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build trust
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}→信頼関係：16095_shinraikankei⟧: a relationship of trust
- {信頼|しんらい}できる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a trustworthy person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe — broader meaning; can mean believing facts, stories, or people; less emphasis on reliability
- ⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on, depend on — focuses on depending on someone for help rather than trusting their character
- ⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧: to entrust — means leaving a task or responsibility to someone

USAGE:
The noun form ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧ is very common on its own. Often appears in the passive ({信頼|しんらい}される) to describe someone who is trusted. The phrase {信頼|しんらい}できる functions as a modifier meaning 'trustworthy.'
